_comment: Auto-generated by scripts/refresh_cli_models.py — do not edit by hand, EXCEPT default_model keys, which are human-owned config the refresh carries through (and validates against the extracted model list). Refreshed daily by .github/workflows/refresh-cli-models.yml.

codex._extra_models_note: Human-owned, carried through the daily refresh. The binary's embedded slug list omits codex-family ids even though the CLI accepts them; on the API-KEY path they are the ONLY models codex-rs exposes MCP servers to (2026-07-17 matrix), so API-key users with tools wired need one offered. ChatGPT-auth accounts REJECT them (400) and instead get tools on their account's general models via the stock originator - which is why they are extras, not the default.

openclaw._version_frozen: openclaw 2026.9.2 publishes its workspace bootstrap files (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, ...) with a hard link and fails when link(2) is refused; the per-conversation workspace is a Modal volume, which refuses it, so every new conversation's first turn errors. Frozen at 2026.9.1 until that path works on our volumes (or bootstrap is skipped by config); refresh_cli_models.py skips bumping openclaw.
